claude.label: Claude Code
claude.missingHint: This sandbox's image has no claude-acp-start (the claude-agent-acp ACP adapter). Rebuild it in openshell-configs with `make claude-sandbox` (or `make images` for claude-browser and claude-hyperframes too), then recreate the sandbox.

agy.label: Antigravity CLI
agy.missingHint: This sandbox's image has no agy-acp-start (the google-antigravity-acp adapter around agy). Rebuild it in openshell-configs with `make agy-sandbox`, then recreate the sandbox. If agy asks you to sign in, log in once with `bin/sandbox.sh agy <sandbox>`.
